subject: Private deployment: on‑prem pricing, support tiers & invoice cadence
messages:
From: Jane Li <jane.li@acmehealth.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:14:23 -0800
Subject: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Acme Health is evaluating an on‑prem (air‑gapped) deployment for PHI workloads and we need a loud estimate for licensing, platform fee, and support tiers so we can size our procurement ask. High level details:
- Initial environment: 8x A100 equivalent GPUs, expected peak 100 qps for chat generation with 2K token context
- Year 1: pilot (3 months) then production (9 months)
- Compliance: SOC2 plus SAML + audit logging

Could you send a breakdown (license vs platform fee vs support) and preferred invoicing cadence (Net30/Net45/Net60)? I attached a draft SOW (Acme_SOW_v1.pdf).

Also include any credits or concessions available for pilot -> committed expansion. We have a procurement window starting Jan 15.

Appreciate it —
Jane Li
Director, Cloud Architecture
Acme Health

From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:38:11 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear brief and the SOW. High level estimate attached (Redwood_VPC_Pricing_20261211.xlsx). Key points up front:

1) Licensing: one‑time on‑prem license (per GPU) + model bundle licensing if you want Redwood‑verified weights in the appliance. For 8 A100 equivalents, license is $240k one‑time (covers software runtime + minor customizations).

2) Platform fee (annual): covers control plane updates, telemetry aggregation (when allowed), and access to the Redwood Console for rollouts. Base platform fee options: Standard $120k/yr, Enterprise $200k/yr.

3) Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 24‑hour RTO on critical), Premium (24/7, 2‑hour response) — Standard is $36k/yr, Premium $120k/yr.

Pilot concessions we can offer: up to 15% credit on platform fee in year 1 for a signed annual commitment after the pilot; onboarding professional services (up to 30 hours) included for the pilot. Invoice cadence: default Net45 for new enterprise customers; we can consider Net60 on approved credit.

I know you called out SOC2 and SAML — our SOC2 report and SSO package are in the MSA (attached draft MSA_Redwood_v2.docx). If the timeline is Jan 15 procurement, we should aim to finalize commercial terms this week so legal can review the SOW + MSA.

Next steps: I copied our finance and AE team (Ben, Laura, Tessa) to align on concessions and invoicing. I can do a short call tomorrow to walk the pricing workbook.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Pricing_20261211.xlsx, MSA_Redwood_v2.docx

From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:05:44 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines — concession request

Team — forwarding Acme's ask and my estimate. They explicitly asked for pilot credits and more flexible invoicing (Net60).

What I proposed: up to 15% platform fee credit Y1 + 30 hours onboarding PS. Procurement may push for a larger concession (they mentioned internal budget limits). Two options I think we can present:
A) Competitive concession: 15% platform fee credit Y1, Standard support, Net45 invoice (no prepay)
B) Aggressive close: 20% platform fee credit Y1, Standard support, Net60 first invoice, 12‑month commit guarantee (minimum committed spend $350k)

Numbers in workbook are annotated. I need finance to confirm what we can allow without exec sign. Laura — can you confirm if Net60 + 20% credit needs VP approval? Ben — if we soften to 15% + onboarding credits, can you close with the AE motion?

– Logan

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 10:38 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jane — thanks for the clear brief and the SOW...

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 11:22:08 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines — concession request

Agree with framing. Quick finance note: Net60 materially increases credit exposure. Laura, if we require Net60 on first invoice we should either (a) require the 12‑month minimum commit, or (b) move the first payment to milestone (50% on signing, 50% on go‑live) with Net45 on each invoice.

Suggested commercial to send to Acme:
- One‑time license: $240k
- Platform fee: $120k/yr less 15% pilot credit in Y1 -> $102k Y1
- Support: Standard $36k/yr (includes onboarding credits equivalent to 30 hours PS)
- Payment: milestone invoicing (50% on signature, 50% on production go‑live) or Net45 Net45 on each milestone; if they require Net60, tie to $350k minimum commit.

If they push for 20% we should ask for a 12‑month commit and an up‑front baseline payment (30%). With that, sales can greenlight 20% platform credit.

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops

From: Jane Li <jane.li@acmehealth.com>
To: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:04:50 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines

Logan — thanks for the detailed breakdown and the options. A few clarifications from procurement and security:

1) Discount: given our internal capex constraints we'd prefer the aggressive concession (20% platform fee credit in Y1). If Redwood can do that with a 12‑month commit it's reasonable.
2) Invoice cadence: Procurement prefers Net60 for standard vendors; we can agree to milestone invoicing but would like Net60 on the final invoice.
3) Compliance: SAML + SOC2 are mandatory — please confirm these are in the MSA. We will also need an audit log export format for our SIEM (they want a sample schema).
4) Timeline: procurement deadline Jan 15 — we need a redlined MSA + updated SOW and a commercial term sheet to present to leadership by Mon, Dec 20.

If you can send an updated commercial with the 20% concession tied to a $350k minimum commitment and milestone invoicing (Net60 on final invoice), we can escalate internally. Otherwise, we may need to go to other vendors.

Best,
Jane

From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:22:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health: on‑prem deployment pricing & timelines — final proposal

Jane — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We reviewed internally and here's a proposal intended to hit Acme's procurement constraints while protecting Redwood's credit exposure:

Commercial summary (final):
- One‑time on‑prem license: $240,000 (covers runtime + initial model bundle)
- Platform fee: $120,000/yr
  - Pilot concession: 15% credit applied to Year 1 platform fee ($18,000 credit)
  - Option: increase to 20% credit if Acme executes the $350k minimum committed spend (documented in commercial term sheet)
- Support: Standard $36,000/yr (includes 30 hours onboarding PS)

Payment/Invoice cadence:
- Preferred: milestone invoicing (50% on signature, 50% on production go‑live) with Net45 on each milestone
- If Acme requires Net60 on the final invoice, Redwood can accept Net60 provided the $350k minimum commit is executed and the first milestone (signature) is paid at signing (30% up‑front).

Compliance and deliverables:
- SOC2 attestation and SAML support included in the MSA (see attached MSA_Redwood_v2.docx).
- We will produce an audit log export schema for your SIEM by the SOW delivery milestone (sample attached to SOW).

Next steps:
1) I attached an updated Invoice_Proposal_20261218.pdf and an updated term summary.
2) If Acme confirms the $350k commit, we will increase the Year 1 platform credit to 20% and issue the final redline to the MSA + SOW.
3) We can send a DocuSign packet for signature (MSA + commercial term sheet) — link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templatelink/abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6789012
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAcme-SOW

I copied Ben and Laura to accelerate the finance approvals on Net60 exceptions. If you confirm the commit by EOD Mon (Dec 20), procurement can make your window.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Invoice_Proposal_20261218.pdf, MSA_Redwood_v2.docx
